text:
lee_support: FYI — PayMint (acct paymint-prod) opened a P1: transactions failing during live ingest. Customer is mid-renewal (10 days). Need CS to own comms & priority handling. Error samples below. @sarah_cs can you take point?

maria_se: Repro on staging by sending batch of 500 txns over websocket — we see 502 from inference svc. Log: ```ERROR inference: shard-3 kvcache eviction failed: OOM while allocating 64MB at step 124``` Happened 3x in last hour.

sarah_cs: On it. I'll draft a customer note and sync with AE. Proposed comms: immediate acknowledge + root cause commit within 4h, workaround instructions, daily check-ins until resolved.

tom_ae: +1. We're 10 days from renewal; customer's CSM is nervous. I'll join the first war room and loop exec sponsor if we get SLA breach.

jen_eng_oncall: Eng looking. Mitigation: temporary scale up to 2x replicas for the inference cluster and enable prefix caching for that tenant. ETA ~20m to spin up; rolling deploy will add transient latency.

lee_support: thanks team. I'll tell customer we have a mitigation and will follow up with timeline.

sarah_cs: Drafted note — paste below. Pls comment:
"Hi PayMint team — thanks for flagging. We see increased error rate tied to inference shard OOM. We're applying mitigation (capacity bump + cache) now. Expect reduced errors within 30m. Next update in 2h or earlier. — Sarah (CS)"

maria_se: LGTM. Add contact numbers and link to status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/pm-1958

tom_ae: Also add renewal escalation contact and next steps for contract team.

sarah_cs: I'll send after eng confirms mitigation live. @jen_eng_oncall ping when done.

jen_eng_oncall: Mitigation live — replicas x2 and cache enabled for paymint-tenant. Error rate down to <1% in last 10m. Rolling monitor and will watch for regressions. :thumbsup:

lee_support: Customer updated with mitigation and next steps. They asked for a postmortem and impact calc for renewal. Can CS own PM and resourcing for that?

sarah_cs: Yes. I'll run the postmortem, include timeline, token usage delta, and proposed goodwill credit. Will coordinate with finance + AE.

tom_ae: I'll push for a short-term credit to appease them. Keep me in the loop.

deploy-bot: [deploy] scale inference cluster +2 replicas for paymint-tenant succeeded at 1958765520

sarah_cs: Thanks everyone. I'll set a follow-up thread for the postmortem and a customer-ready summary.
